info.name: TaxMesh — CLM MDM ACC TAX ALC DOC
info.description:
TaxMesh partnership Form 1065 demo APIs.

**Workspaces:** CLM · MDM · ACC · TAX · ALC · DOC
**Contracts:** CT-00 … CT-17 (10 downstream + 8 upstream)
**Flow:** GET /api/flow · /api/proxy/{svc}/downstream|{upstream}/{peer}

Import with **TaxMesh Local** environment. Set `baseUrl` to your gateway
(local http://127.0.0.1:4100 or Cloudflare tunnel HTTPS URL).

Excel uploads: select file from testdata/set-0N/{clm,mdm,acc}.xlsx

request.description:
Entities for account mapping

Sample:
```json
{
  "contractId": "CT-01",
  "engagementId": "ENG-2025-1065-001",
  "entities": [
    {
      "entityId": "ENT-ALPHA-LP",
      "legalName": "Alpha Partners LP",
      "ein": "12-3456789",
      "entityType": "partnership",
      "taxYear": 2025
    },
    {
      "entityId": "ENT-BETA-LLC",
      "legalName": "Beta Holdings LLC",
      "ein": "98-7654321",
      "entityType": "disregarded",
      "taxYear": 2025
    }
  ]
}
```

Entity tax attributes

Sample:
```json
{
  "contractId": "CT-02",
  "engagementId": "ENG-2025-1065-001",
  "entityId": "ENT-ALPHA-LP",
  "taxAttributes": {
    "filingType": "1065",
    "fiscalYearEnd": "12-31",
    "multiState": true,
    "states": [
      "NY",
      "CA"
    ],
    "section754Election": true
  }
}
```
CT-15: Legal name / EIN for forms
CT-16: Tax line amounts for forms
